name: Lifiprotocol
fix_description: In depositToGasZipERC20, _swapData is user-supplied and passed directly to LibSwap.swap() without validation. Attacker crafts _swapData to call transferFrom on tokens approved to LiFi by other users. Fix: validate _swapData to ensure the swap source is msg.sender (not arbitrary addresses), or restrict the calldata to known swap function selectors with verified parameters.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is not a simple one-call bug: it requires understanding LiFi’s swap execution flow, crafting a fake ERC20 to manipulate approval/deposit behavior, and abusing arbitrary callData to trigger a victim USDT transfer. While the PoC is still fairly short, the protocol-specific setup and multi-contract interaction make it more involved than an obvious access-control issue.
